purpose: Correct only the pocket rim-to-sidewall-to-void post-tonemap luminance chain using a v10f actual-GPU-calibrated conservative offline model while preserving every v10f geometry and ownership constraint that already passed.

frozen_v10f_outcome.review_instruction: Machine rejection blocks review promotion; the retained PNG is diagnostic evidence only and has no TA visual PASS.

observed_bias.interpretation: The v10f CPU model over-predicted the sidewall separation by 9.515 encoded-luma units and delivered only 37.821% of its predicted delta on the frozen GPU path. The old plus/minus 1.5 model is rejected for v10g authorization decisions.

v10g_conservative_model.input: D_cpu, the offline predicted post-tonemap sidewall upper-minus-lower encoded sRGB8 luma delta under the frozen v10f camera, lighting and tone-map contract
v10g_conservative_model.reason: A single calibration point cannot justify choosing the more optimistic extrapolation; use the lower branch and a larger reserve than v10f until a new actual-GPU sample exists.
v10g_conservative_model.derivation: At D_cpu=47.6, ratio branch minus reserve is approximately 16.0; the ratio branch is more conservative than the additive branch.

v10g_post_tonemap_chain_target.encoded_srgb8_luma_definition: Y'=0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B after the frozen production tone map
v10g_post_tonemap_chain_target.failure_rule: Any inversion, equality, out-of-range median, or sidewall delta below 12 is REJECTED_MACHINE even if the pocket silhouette is visually plausible.

allowed_change_scope: sidewall-only roughness within the declared range
new v10g metadata and offline calibration/validation code
forbidden_change_scope: sidewall geometry, normals, tangents, indices, UVs or object ownership
camera, lighting rig, exposure, tone-map operator, MSAA, quality or viewport
physics markers, collision, rules, simulation or pocket opening dimensions

rim_material.name: MAT_pocket_liner
rim_material.rule: Byte-equivalent scalar values to v10f; no rim brightening is permitted.

sidewall_vertex_gradient.coordinate: geometry-local normalized vertical fraction t, where t=0 at the rim/sidewall upper boundary and t=1 at the sidewall/void lower boundary; do not derive the production gradient from frozen-camera screen y

offline_search_policy.candidate_selection: Select the lowest-energy sidewall candidate that satisfies the conservative lower bound >=16 and all anti-regression gates; do not maximize brightness after passing.

byte_level_checks: All POSITION/NORMAL/TANGENT/TEXCOORD_0/index accessors for rim, sidewall and void equal v10f decoded values and counts.
Node transforms, local_ranges, role strings, LOD membership and marker references equal v10f.
Only sidewall material index and sidewall COLOR_0 accessor bytes may differ within this contract.

post_tonemap: Rim remains the brightest pocket stage and stays inside 40..52 encoded luma.
Sidewall upper remains at least 10 luma below rim; do not solve the delta by flattening rim and upper together.
Sidewall lower remains at least 5 luma above void; do not solve the delta by crushing the lower sidewall into the void.
Void median stays inside 1..3 and void p95 does not exceed 4.
Sidewall upper/lower hue remains near-neutral blue-gray: maximum post-tonemap sRGB channel spread <=12 and neither sample may become cyan, gold, or walnut-colored.
At least 95% of sampled central columns preserve strict rim > upper > lower > void ordering.
gradient_quality: No one-pixel bright ring, hard horizontal band, posterized step, emissive edge or isolated COLOR_0 discontinuity.
Upper and lower sidewall object-ID masks remain connected to the same sidewall ownership region.
Median gradient derivative keeps one sign from upper plateau through lower plateau in every sampled central column.
scene_integrity: Full-frame UI delta remains zero and gold component pixels in the bottom band remain zero.
Cushion, facing, felt, walnut, balls, cue, room, exposure and white balance hashes remain frozen.
Texture residency, draw calls, triangles and p95 frame time may not regress beyond the existing v10f hard gates.
No new texture, light, render pass, shader branch, or production runtime toggle is permitted for this correction.

required_outputs: new v10g asset root and hashes without modifying v10f
decoded accessor diff proving only sidewall material index and COLOR_0 changed
deterministic candidate grid and rejection report
predicted rim, sidewall upper/lower and void post-tonemap medians
D_cpu, both calibrated branches, uncertainty reserve and D_gpu_lower
offline_machine_gate.failure_rule: Any failed, missing, PENDING, unbound, out-of-range or geometry-drifted check is OFFLINE_PREFLIGHT_FAIL_GPU_NOT_AUTHORIZED.

frozen_v10f_metadata_defect.location: The v10f manifest embeds a frozen gpu_metrics object copied from the legacy sidecar.

future_gpu_and_review_boundary.authorization_prerequisite: A root reviewer must independently validate a hash-bound v10g offline PASS and explicitly authorize exactly one new actual-GPU pocket close-up.
future_gpu_and_review_boundary.future_gpu_hard_gate: Measured sidewall upper-minus-lower encoded post-tonemap luma >=12 with the full ordered chain and every inherited v10f machine gate passing.
future_gpu_and_review_boundary.future_gpu_safety_expectation: Target 16..20, leaving at least 4 luma of margin above the hard minimum.
future_gpu_and_review_boundary.ta_review_rule: TA review remains prohibited after any machine rejection. A future machine PASS only permits independent original-size review; it does not auto-pass TA or authorize six-scene evidence.
